characters.title: Characters
characters.subtitle: Distill characters from your media works into dialogue-ready personas.
characters.distill_desc: Pick a work from your collection or type a title — its characters are looked up automatically, so tap a bubble or type any name; extra material is optional. Hit Distill to generate a structured character card.
characters.work_name_placeholder: Enter a work title, e.g. Spirited Away
characters.suggest_need_key: Configure an AI key to auto-list this work's characters.
characters.suggest_empty: No characters found — type one below.
characters.suggest_hint: Tap a bubble to pick a character, or type any custom name.
characters.character_name_placeholder: Enter the character to distill, e.g. Chihiro
characters.empty_collection: Your collection is empty — you can type a work title directly.
characters.extra_material_hint: Paste synopses, reviews, episode summaries, interviews...
characters.extra_material_note: Extra material takes priority over AI knowledge. Re-distilling the same work merges profiles incrementally and keeps corrections.
characters.distill_failed: Distillation failed. Check your AI settings and try again.
characters.error_key_rejected: The provider rejected the API key (401). The key may not match the selected provider — open AI Config, check the provider, enter its key and re-test the connection.
characters.error_bad_output: The AI did not return parseable character JSON (the output may have been truncated, or the model does not support it). Try another model or a higher Max Tokens value.
characters.error_no_key: No AI API key configured. Set one in AI Config first.
characters.error_no_ai: The AI returned an empty response. The model may have spent its entire output budget on reasoning (raise Max Tokens in AI Config), or the key/model is unavailable.
characters.empty_desc: Distill your first character from a movie, TV series, book or comic in your collection, then chat with them in character.
characters.profile_hint: Character traits are hidden by default — click a section title to reveal it.
characters.delete_confirm_desc: The persona profile and all its chat sessions will be removed. This cannot be undone.
characters.no_corrections: No corrections yet. Use "Adjust persona" during a chat when the character feels off.
characters.correction_saved: Persona updated — applies to the next reply

character_chat.reply_failed: Failed to get a reply. Please try again.
character_chat.reply_failed_auth: The provider rejected the API key (401). Open AI Config to check that the key matches the provider, then re-test the connection.
character_chat.reply_empty: The model returned nothing — its output budget may have been consumed by reasoning. Raise Max Tokens in AI Config or switch models.
character_chat.adjust_persona_desc: Tell the character how to behave differently. Saved corrections are injected into every future reply and override the distilled persona.
character_chat.input_placeholder: Message {{name}}... (Enter to send, Shift+Enter for a new line)
character_chat.empty_desc: The conversation stays in character: persona, expression style and your corrections are applied to every reply.

update.available_toast: New version v{{version}} is available — open the Dashboard page to update
update.up_to_date: You are on the latest version

error.network: Could not reach the update server (GitHub). Check your network connection; if accessing GitHub requires a proxy on your network, enable it and try again.
error.timeout: The connection to the update server timed out — usually an unstable network or blocked access to GitHub. Check your network (enable a proxy if needed) and retry.
error.tls: The secure connection (HTTPS) to the update server failed verification. Check that your system clock is correct and your network is not intercepting certificates.
error.not_found: No update manifest (latest.json) was found on the update server. The latest release may still be publishing — retry later or check the GitHub Releases page.
error.rate_limit: The update source (GitHub) is temporarily rate-limiting requests. Try again in a few minutes.
error.server: The update server is having temporary issues. Try again later.
error.signature: Update signature verification failed — the package may be corrupted or mismatched. Download it again from the GitHub Releases page.
error.parse: Failed to parse the update manifest; the server returned malformed data. Try again later.
error.unknown: An unknown error occurred. If it keeps failing, download the update manually from the GitHub Releases page.

update.restart_hint: Restart to start using the new version. Your data (collection, login state, etc.) is preserved.
